title: World Bloom — Searching for Sunken Shadows — Episode5 Words Of Kindness

meta.Event Outline: Mafuyu is now living with Kanade after running away, and all four members of Nightcord at 25:00 are working together again. As they each turn their thoughts to the future, something begins to shift in the Empty SEKAI...

rows.Line: Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
*Stretch*
I feel so much better after talking to you, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Now, let's go check out this new area.
Wanna come with?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'll pass.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I don't know where it is! What if I get lost?! Can you live with that?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
You won't get lost.
It's straight ahead this way.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
That's still too vague!
Can't you come with me?! Pretty please!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
*Cry*
MEIKO hates me.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: She doesn't care if I get lost.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm going.
se_walk_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Aww, come on!
You're really not coming with me?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I just said I'm going...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm leaving you behind if you don't hurry it up.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh...
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey! All you said was, “I'm going.”
I thought that meant you were headed somewhere else!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I guess this means you're nicer than you let on, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And I guess this means you want to get left behind...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Whoa, hey! Wait for me!
C'mon, let's go together♪
se_walk_women_001_1
se_walk_women_001_3

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Cool...!
So this is the new area...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But it's a lake... Right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, that's what it seems to be.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hmm... It seems to go pretty far.
Do you think there's something waiting for us on the other side?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Who knows...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, can't you at least try to play along?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I thought you were looking for Rin...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, right!
Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, Rin! Miku!
se_walk_women_001_1
se_walk_women_001_3

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I didn't know you were here, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, I was so surprised when I heard the news!
This place just sprang up overnight, huh?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Also, what are you two reading...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh... A children's picture book.
It came out of the lake.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What? Wait, out of the lake?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Mafuyu's feelings manifest themselves in this SEKAI. I'm sure this lake is connected somehow.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And despite being very clear, it's too deep to see the bottom. Her feelings may be hiding somewhere down there...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Mafuyu's feelings...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Then, does this picture book also mean something?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, I believe so.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
By the way, what's it about?
Can I read it with you guys?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Sure.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Thanks!
Then, lemme squeeze in♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, let's have a look...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: “Once upon a time, there was a little rabbit.”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: “She lived a very happy life with her mommy rabbit and daddy rabbit.”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, that's pretty cute...
I kinda want to animate these rabbits now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'd like to see that as well.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, then, maybe I'll do just that!
I'll get Ena to do all of the illustrations.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Are you gonna keep reading?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, right. Where were we?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: “The little rabbit was a very nice girl.”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: “She did her best to help others because seeing them smile made her very happy.”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: “She also loved seeing her mommy and daddy smile, so she helped them as much as she could.”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: “Whenever her mommy asked her to clean her room, she'd clean and clean and clean until it became spotless.”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: “Whenever her daddy asked her to go buy something for him, she'd take her little basket and get whatever he needed as quickly as she could.”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: “She also knew that studying lots and lots would make them proud. And so, she did.”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: “As time went on, the little rabbit learned to do many different things.”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: “She tried so hard that she started getting tired.”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait, this sounds like...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: “Even so she kept trying and trying because she knew that's what would make everybody happy.”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: “But then, she started to forget why she was working so hard and what she really wanted to do.”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: “Still, even when she was in pain and so tired that she had very little energy to keep going, she kept doing what she could for others.”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: “But trying and trying started to make her chest feel colder and colder. Until eventually, she couldn't keep going.”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh...
Mizuki, look at the next page...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: “That was when the dog, hedgehog and cat came to save her.”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: “The dog played warm-sounding music for her.”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: “The hedgehog drew pictures of the rabbit going forward even when she was lost.”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: “And the cat said nice things to her.”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Nice things...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: “The dog's music helped the rabbit open her eyes once more.”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: “The hedgehog's pictures helped her feel hopeful about the future.”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: “And the cat's words...”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: “And the cat's words helped her escape the place where she had become trapped.”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: “As sad and painful as it was to leave...”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: “With the help of the others, the rabbit was able to protect what mattered most to her.”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: “And then, the rabbit...”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? That's it...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, the last pages are blank...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha. That's pretty cool...
It's like an illustration of Mafuyu's current situation...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I guess it makes sense that we'd find this in Mafuyu's SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, I agree...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Which means...
This story may be based on Mafuyu's feelings.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Mafuyu's feelings, huh...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm glad this rabbit's friends were there for her when she really needed them...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I doubt she could've escaped without them.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (In this story, the dog used music, the hedgehog used art and the cat said nice things to her.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (So, does this mean what I said really helped...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Thanks, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm gonna see what I can do about dealing with my own problems.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I mean, I can't let cottontail here hog all the glory.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Is that so?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Then, do your best.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I will!

rows.Speaker: Movie
